critical_code_review_comments: social.py: TEXT_MODEL='gemini-3.5-flash' and IMAGE_MODEL='gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' — hardcoded model names; consider env-driven (SOCIAL_TEXT_MODEL/SOCIAL_IMAGE_MODEL) so admin can swap without redeploy, matching the 'everything administrable' brief.

admin.py PUT /plans: no schema validation of plan objects (accepts any list). Should validate each item has id in {free,creator,studio} and required entitlement/limit shape to avoid corruption via admin UI.

social.py update_post uses PostUpdateIn (all optional) but body.model_dump() would set None fields as absent — currently OK, but PostUpdateIn is also reused for /schedule which requires network+scheduled_at; consider a distinct ScheduleIn model for clarity.
video/generate: on quota_exceeded, response still uses 403 (semantically 429 is more correct). Frontend already handles the specific 'quota_exceeded' detail so functional, but non-conventional.
